main_text.p: Hæc de modo; ratione tem-poris ut moderata sit defensio, requiritur ut ea fiat confestim, non ex intervallo. Neque e-nim aliter defensio esse videbitur, quàm quidem de novo inchoata offensio. l. 3. §. 9. verf. sed non D. de vi & vi armat. l. 17. D. eod. l. 7. §. 4. verf. Si cedentem, D. ad l. Aquil. Damhaud. Prax. crim. cap. 76. n. 10.

page.notes: The citation block at the top is set in smaller italic type and reads as a continuation of notes from the previous page; it is kept as a foot paragraph. Doubtful: "Bapt." (printed as "B ipt." or similar), and the numeral after "tit. 2" in "tit. 23." (printed as a crowded figure, possibly 23 or 21). "Bajard" is also slightly unclear. The "XVIII." and "XIX." numbers are section numbers and are written as paragraphs, not headings. "XIX." is treated as the catchword because it stands at the right below the last line.
